summary: Medirom Healthcare Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing an update on its Nasdaq listing compliance. The company had previously received a notice for failure to timely file its Form 20-F for FY2025. Nasdaq granted an extension to November 11, 2026, to regain compliance. The company continues working to file the form. If compliance is not achieved, Nasdaq will initiate delisting of its ADSs, subject to appeal. The filing is a routine regulatory update on listing standards, not a special-situation event such as a delisting or restructuring. What to watch: the timing of the Form 20-F filing and potential delisting risk if missed.
